summary: Variation Orders V2 tested end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass covering reference, stats, CRUD with VO-NNN ref generation & VAT/subtotal/total math, PATCH auto-stamp of approvedDate on Approved, list filters + search, soft delete, templates, project roll-up (originalContractValue + approvedValue = revisedContractValue), /api/jobs/{id}/stats returning approvedVariationsValue + revisedContractValue + openVariations, and /api/attention endpoint not erroring. Frontend on public URL with darrenhustle300: dashboard renders all 5 status stat cards + 3 KPI value cards + search/filter/CTA, /app/tool/variation-letter correctly redirects to /app/variation-orders, wizard opens & walks 9 steps, cost breakdown computes £300 (4x50 + 5x20), Save & Generate PDF closes wizard and shows 'Variation saved' toast with new VO-007 row, Draft row Submit action moves it to Submitted (dashboard counters update live). No console errors seen. Mobile viewport: page renders and is usable but stat cards stack in 1 column instead of the 2 columns mentioned in the spec — minor design gap.

issues: The 5 status stat cards render single-column on mobile. Spec asked for 2-column stacking on mobile. Consider grid-cols-2 at sm breakpoint to match Quote Builder/Site Diary layouts.

action_items: (Design polish, non-blocking) Update stat card grid on VariationOrders.jsx to render 2 columns on mobile widths (e.g. grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-5).
critical_code_review_comments: variation_orders.py is a clean, well-scoped module. _shape() correctly strips ObjectId. VO reference counter (_seq_ref) uses find_one_and_update — atomic, good.
PATCH endpoint recomputes totals only when pricing keys are touched — correct optimization.
auto-stamp of approvedDate only sets when transitioning to Approved AND no prior approvedDate — good idempotency.
project_workspace.py /jobs/{id}/stats correctly aggregates approvedVariationsValue and computes revisedContractValue as contractValue + approvedVariationsValue.

VariationOrders.jsx is a large single file — main wizard is ~750 lines with dashboard. Approaching the 700-line guideline; splitting wizard steps into subcomponents would improve maintainability, matching feedback given for RiskRegister.jsx in iteration_21.
seed_data_creation: Backend test file creates TEST_-prefixed variations, a TEST_ job, and TEST_ templates, and cleans them up in the terminal test. During UI walkthrough one 'TEST_UI VO Project' variation was created and left on the account (VO-007, then Submitted); harmless but can be deleted from UI if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file at /app/backend/tests/test_variation_orders.py — runs against public URL, self-cleans. VO frontend testids all use 'vo-' prefix. Photo picker + Quote link and command-centre attention (>7 day stale variation) were not deep-tested via UI because they need pre-existing media/quotes and time-shifted rows; backend attention endpoint itself was verified to return 200 without error, and the collector logic was code-reviewed. Approved date auto-stamp confirmed by pytest.
